title: Concerned about Ray-Ban Meta camera in public gym
text: I noticed someone wearing Ray-Ban Meta glasses in the locker room. The recording light is so tiny that nobody notices. Does EssilorLuxottica have any privacy safeguards or is this all on Meta?

title: Smart Glasses Face Renewed European Privacy Scrutiny
text: Data protection authorities across Europe are reviewing whether Meta and Ray-Ban maker EssilorLuxottica provided sufficient transparency regarding passive bystander recording.
